options.content:
### Chest X-ray classifier — versioning & drift monitoring
A story in three acts, read top to bottom. **① The data:** dataset **v1** is the original A1 data; **v2** is the same images through a simulated *new scanner* (brighter, lower contrast). **② The models:** the MLflow registry holds the A1 model (**v1**), a model retrained on drifted data (**v2**, `@champion`) and a **control** (**v3**) trained the same way on the old data. **③ Live traffic:** predictions logged by the app. Vertical markers show where each traffic batch starts — watch image brightness and the PNEUMONIA share jump when drifted images arrive, with no labels needed, and settle when the retrained model takes over.

Sources: MLflow's Postgres tables (registry, runs, metrics) and the app's `app_predictions` log.

panels.title: ① The data — what changed between dataset versions
Dataset versions (MLflow dataset runs)
panels.description: One row per dataset version logged in Step 1. The digest is a hash of the dataset's contents: same digest = provably the same data.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT ds.version AS "Version",
       (SELECT value FROM tags WHERE run_uuid = ds.run_uuid AND key = 'dataset_digest') AS "Digest",
       (SELECT value FROM tags WHERE run_uuid = ds.run_uuid AND key = 'parent_version') AS "Derived from",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'n_images' THEN m.value END) AS "Images",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'n_train' THEN m.value END) AS "Train",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'n_val' THEN m.value END) AS "Val",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'n_test' THEN m.value END) AS "Test",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'pct_pneumonia_test' THEN m.value END) AS "% PNEUMONIA (test)",
       coalesce((SELECT 'contrast ×' || max(CASE WHEN key = 'drift_contrast_factor' THEN value END)
                  || ', brightness ×' || max(CASE WHEN key = 'drift_brightness_factor' THEN value END)
                  FROM params WHERE run_uuid = ds.run_uuid), '—') AS "Drift applied"
FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid
GROUP BY ds.version, ds.run_uuid ORDER BY ds.version

panels.title: Drift score · brightness (PSI)
panels.description: Population Stability Index, v2 vs v1: <0.1 stable, 0.1–0.25 moderate, >0.25 major shift.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'psi_mean_intensity') AS "PSI brightness"

panels.title: Drift score · contrast (PSI)
panels.description: Population Stability Index, v2 vs v1: <0.1 stable, 0.1–0.25 moderate, >0.25 major shift.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'psi_std_intensity') AS "PSI contrast"

panels.title: Image statistics by dataset version
panels.description: Average brightness and contrast (0–255 pixel scale). The drift made images brighter and flatter; everything else (files, labels, split) is identical.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT 'Brightness (mean pixel)' AS "measure",
       (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v1' AND m.key = 'mean_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v1", (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'mean_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v2"
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Contrast (std of pixels)',
       (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v1' AND m.key = 'std_intensity_avg'), (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'std_intensity_avg')

panels.title: ② The models — what the registry knows
Registered model versions
panels.description: From the MLflow model registry: aliases, the dataset each version was trained on, test metrics at 0.50, and the threshold chosen on validation (Step 2b).

targets.rawSql:
WITH mv AS (
  SELECT v.version, v.run_id,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'model_role' THEN g.value END) AS role,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'train_dataset_version' THEN g.value END) AS trained_on,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v1' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v1,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v2' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v2
  FROM model_versions v
  LEFT JOIN model_version_tags g ON g.name = v.name AND g.version = v.version
  WHERE v.name = 'xray-pneumonia-classifier'
  GROUP BY v.version, v.run_id),
label AS (
  SELECT version, run_id, role, trained_on, thr_v1, thr_v2,
         'v' || version || ' ' || CASE role WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'A1 baseline'
                                            WHEN 'retrained_for_drift' THEN 'drift-retrained'
                                            WHEN 'control' THEN 'control' ELSE role END AS model
  FROM mv), cal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (tv.value) tv.value::int AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN tags tr ON tr.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tr.key = 'model_role' AND tr.value = 'calibration'
  JOIN tags tv ON tv.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tv.key = 'calibrated_model_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY tv.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT l.model AS "Model version",
       coalesce((SELECT string_agg('@' || alias, ' ' ORDER BY alias) FROM registered_model_aliases a
                 WHERE a.name = 'xray-pneumonia-classifier' AND a.version = l.version), '') AS "Aliases",
       l.trained_on AS "Trained on",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v1_f1_macro' THEN m.value END) AS "F1 test v1",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v2_f1_macro' THEN m.value END) AS "F1 test v2",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v2_recall_normal' THEN m.value END) AS "NORMAL recall v2",
       l.thr_v2 AS "Threshold v2 (val)",
       (SELECT cm.value FROM cal JOIN latest_metrics cm ON cm.run_uuid = cal.run_uuid
        WHERE cal.version = l.version AND cm.key = 'test_v2_f1_macro_at_threshold') AS "F1 v2 @ val threshold"
FROM label l JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = l.run_id
GROUP BY l.version, l.model, l.trained_on, l.thr_v2 ORDER BY l.version

matcher.options: ^(F1 test v1|F1 test v2|NORMAL recall v2|F1 v2 @ val threshold)$

panels.title: ${metric:text} by model version and test set (threshold 0.50)
panels.description: Pick the metric with the selector at the top of the dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mv AS (
  SELECT v.version, v.run_id,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'model_role' THEN g.value END) AS role,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'train_dataset_version' THEN g.value END) AS trained_on,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v1' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v1,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v2' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v2
  FROM model_versions v
  LEFT JOIN model_version_tags g ON g.name = v.name AND g.version = v.version
  WHERE v.name = 'xray-pneumonia-classifier'
  GROUP BY v.version, v.run_id),
label AS (
  SELECT version, run_id, role, trained_on, thr_v1, thr_v2,
         'v' || version || ' ' || CASE role WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'A1 baseline'
                                            WHEN 'retrained_for_drift' THEN 'drift-retrained'
                                            WHEN 'control' THEN 'control' ELSE role END AS model
  FROM mv)
SELECT l.model AS "model",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v1_$metric' THEN m.value END) AS "test v1 (original)",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v2_$metric' THEN m.value END) AS "test v2 (drifted)"
FROM label l JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = l.run_id
GROUP BY l.version, l.model ORDER BY l.version

panels.title: Drifted test set: how the threshold is chosen changes the story
panels.description: Macro F1 on the drifted test set. 'Peeking' picks the threshold on the test set itself — shown only to measure how optimistic that would be.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mv AS (
  SELECT v.version, v.run_id,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'model_role' THEN g.value END) AS role,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'train_dataset_version' THEN g.value END) AS trained_on,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v1' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v1,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v2' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v2
  FROM model_versions v
  LEFT JOIN model_version_tags g ON g.name = v.name AND g.version = v.version
  WHERE v.name = 'xray-pneumonia-classifier'
  GROUP BY v.version, v.run_id),
label AS (
  SELECT version, run_id, role, trained_on, thr_v1, thr_v2,
         'v' || version || ' ' || CASE role WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'A1 baseline'
                                            WHEN 'retrained_for_drift' THEN 'drift-retrained'
                                            WHEN 'control' THEN 'control' ELSE role END AS model
  FROM mv), cal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (tv.value) tv.value::int AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN tags tr ON tr.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tr.key = 'model_role' AND tr.value = 'calibration'
  JOIN tags tv ON tv.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND tv.key = 'calibrated_model_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY tv.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT l.model AS "model",
       max(CASE WHEN m.key = 'test_v2_f1_macro' THEN m.value END) AS "default 0.50",
       max(CASE WHEN c.key = 'test_v2_f1_macro_at_threshold' THEN c.value END) AS "chosen on validation (honest)",
       max(CASE WHEN c.key = 'test_v2_oracle_f1_macro' THEN c.value END) AS "best on test (peeking)"
FROM label l
JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = l.run_id
LEFT JOIN cal ON cal.version = l.version
LEFT JOIN latest_metrics c ON c.run_uuid = cal.run_uuid
GROUP BY l.version, l.model ORDER BY l.version

panels.title: Fine-tuning curves — validation macro F1 per epoch
panels.description: Epoch 0 is the A1 model before fine-tuning, on each run's own validation data. The A1 model was never trained in A3, so it has no curve.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mv AS (
  SELECT v.version, v.run_id,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'model_role' THEN g.value END) AS role,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'train_dataset_version' THEN g.value END) AS trained_on,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v1' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v1,
         max(CASE WHEN g.key = 'recommended_threshold_v2' THEN g.value END)::float AS thr_v2
  FROM model_versions v
  LEFT JOIN model_version_tags g ON g.name = v.name AND g.version = v.version
  WHERE v.name = 'xray-pneumonia-classifier'
  GROUP BY v.version, v.run_id),
label AS (
  SELECT version, run_id, role, trained_on, thr_v1, thr_v2,
         'v' || version || ' ' || CASE role WHEN 'baseline' THEN 'A1 baseline'
                                            WHEN 'retrained_for_drift' THEN 'drift-retrained'
                                            WHEN 'control' THEN 'control' ELSE role END AS model
  FROM mv)
SELECT 'epoch ' || x.step AS "epoch",
       max(CASE WHEN l.role = 'retrained_for_drift' THEN x.value END) AS "drift-retrained (data v2)",
       max(CASE WHEN l.role = 'control' THEN x.value END) AS "control (data v1)"
FROM label l JOIN metrics x ON x.run_uuid = l.run_id AND x.key = 'val_f1_macro'
WHERE l.role IN ('retrained_for_drift', 'control')
GROUP BY x.step ORDER BY x.step

panels.title: ③ Live traffic — drift appearing and being fixed
Predictions in time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Predictions" FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')

panels.title: Predicted PNEUMONIA · last 100
panels.description: Share of the last 100 predictions that said PNEUMONIA. Needs no labels — a jump here is an early drift alarm. On undrifted data the A1 model sits near 77% (it over-flags); with 100 images, ±4 points is normal noise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (100 * avg(predicted))::float AS "Predicted PNEUMONIA"
FROM (SELECT predicted FROM app_predictions WHERE ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100) last100

panels.title: Actually PNEUMONIA · last 100 labelled
panels.description: True share in the same traffic (known only because simulated traffic has labels).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (100 * avg(true_label))::float AS "Actually PNEUMONIA"
FROM (SELECT true_label FROM app_predictions WHERE true_label IS NOT NULL AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
      ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100) last100

panels.title: Brightness shift vs dataset v1 · last 100
panels.description: |average brightness of the last 100 images − dataset v1 average|. Input drift, visible before any label arrives.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT abs(avg(p.mean_intensity) - (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v1' AND m.key = 'mean_intensity_avg')) AS "Brightness shift"
FROM (SELECT mean_intensity FROM app_predictions WHERE ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}') ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100) p

panels.title: Accuracy · last 100 labelled

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int))::float AS "Accuracy"
FROM (SELECT predicted, true_label FROM app_predictions WHERE true_label IS NOT NULL AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
      ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100) last100

panels.title: The story, batch by batch — what the model predicted vs the truth
panels.description: One group per simulated traffic batch, in the order they ran. When drifted images reach the old model, predicted PNEUMONIA rises above the true share and accuracy falls; the retrained model brings them back together.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN lag(ts) OVER w IS NULL
                   OR lag(model_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM model_version
                   OR lag(dataset_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM dataset_version
                   OR ts - lag(ts) OVER w > interval '60 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_batch
  FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source = 'simulation'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts)),
b AS (SELECT *, sum(new_batch) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS batch FROM s)
SELECT '#' || lpad(batch::text, 2, '0') || '  model v' || min(model_version) || ' · '
         || min(dataset_version) || ' images' AS "batch",
       (100 * avg(predicted))::float AS "predicted PNEUMONIA %",
       (100 * avg(true_label))::float AS "actually PNEUMONIA %",
       (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int))::float AS "accuracy %"
FROM b GROUP BY b.batch ORDER BY min(ts)

panels.title: Batch by batch — incoming image brightness
panels.description: The label-free drift signal: the average brightness of each batch. Bars are coloured by where the images really came from; the heights alone reveal it (dataset averages: v1 ≈ 123, v2 ≈ 140).

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN lag(ts) OVER w IS NULL
                   OR lag(model_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM model_version
                   OR lag(dataset_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM dataset_version
                   OR ts - lag(ts) OVER w > interval '60 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_batch
  FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source = 'simulation'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts)),
b AS (SELECT *, sum(new_batch) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS batch FROM s)
SELECT '#' || lpad(batch::text, 2, '0') || '  model v' || min(model_version) || ' · '
         || min(dataset_version) || ' images' AS "batch",
       avg(mean_intensity) FILTER (WHERE dataset_version = 'v1') AS "images from v1",
       avg(mean_intensity) FILTER (WHERE dataset_version = 'v2') AS "images from v2"
FROM b GROUP BY b.batch ORDER BY min(ts)

panels.title: Batch summary
panels.description: A new batch starts when the model or the image dataset changes, or after a pause longer than 60 seconds.

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN lag(ts) OVER w IS NULL
                   OR lag(model_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM model_version
                   OR lag(dataset_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM dataset_version
                   OR ts - lag(ts) OVER w > interval '60 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_batch
  FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source = 'simulation'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts)),
b AS (SELECT *, sum(new_batch) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS batch FROM s)
SELECT batch AS "#", min(ts) AS "Started", 'v' || min(model_version) AS "Model",
       min(dataset_version) AS "Images from", count(*) AS "Images",
       (100 * avg(predicted))::float AS "Predicted PNEUMONIA %",
       (100 * avg(true_label))::float AS "Actually PNEUMONIA %",
       (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int))::float AS "Accuracy %",
       avg(mean_intensity) AS "Brightness", avg(std_intensity) AS "Contrast"
FROM b GROUP BY batch ORDER BY min(ts)

panels.title: Predicted PNEUMONIA share per minute, by model version
panels.description: Solid: what the model predicts. Dashed: the true share. The gap widens when drift arrives.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'),
       (100 * avg(predicted) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 1))::float AS "model v1",
       (100 * avg(predicted) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 2))::float AS "model v2",
       (100 * avg(predicted) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 3))::float AS "model v3"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), (100 * avg(true_label))::float AS "actually PNEUMONIA (labels)"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND true_label IS NOT NULL AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Accuracy per minute (labelled traffic), by model version
panels.description: Only possible because simulated traffic carries labels — real traffic usually doesn't, which is why the label-free signals on the left and below matter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'),
       (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 1))::float AS "model v1",
       (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 2))::float AS "model v2",
       (100 * avg((predicted = true_label)::int) FILTER (WHERE model_version = 3))::float AS "model v3"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND true_label IS NOT NULL AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incoming image brightness vs dataset references
panels.description: Average brightness of the images the app received each minute, against the Step 1 averages.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), avg(mean_intensity) AS "incoming images"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT g.t AS "time", (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v1' AND m.key = 'mean_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v1 average",
       (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'mean_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v2 average"
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 minute') AS g(t)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Incoming image contrast vs dataset references

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1m'), avg(std_intensity) AS "incoming images"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND ('${source}' = 'all' OR source = '${source}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH ds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.value) t.value AS version, r.run_uuid
  FROM runs r
  JOIN experiments e ON e.experiment_id = r.experiment_id AND e.name = 'xray-datasets'
  JOIN tags t ON t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'dataset_version'
  WHERE r.lifecycle_stage = 'active'
  ORDER BY t.value, r.start_time DESC)
SELECT g.t AS "time", (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v1' AND m.key = 'std_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v1 average",
       (SELECT m.value FROM ds JOIN latest_metrics m ON m.run_uuid = ds.run_uuid WHERE ds.version = 'v2' AND m.key = 'std_intensity_avg') AS "dataset v2 average"
FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 minute') AS g(t)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Prediction log (latest 200)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS "Time", source AS "Source", 'v' || model_version AS "Model",
       dataset_version AS "Images from", image_ref AS "Image",
       CASE true_label WHEN 1 THEN 'PNEUMONIA' WHEN 0 THEN 'NORMAL' END AS "Truth",
       CASE predicted WHEN 1 THEN 'PNEUMONIA' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS "Predicted",
       prob_pneumonia AS "P(pneumonia)", mean_intensity AS "Brightness", std_intensity AS "Contrast",
       latency_ms AS "Latency (ms)"
FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200

list.name: source
list.label: Traffic
list.query: Simulated batches only : simulation, All traffic (incl. hand-picked) : all

list.name: metric
list.label: Metric
list.query: Macro F1 : f1_macro, Accuracy : accuracy, ROC-AUC : roc_auc, NORMAL recall : recall_normal, PNEUMONIA recall : recall_pneumonia

target.rawSql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN lag(ts) OVER w IS NULL
                   OR lag(model_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM model_version
                   OR lag(dataset_version) OVER w IS DISTINCT FROM dataset_version
                   OR ts - lag(ts) OVER w > interval '60 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_batch
  FROM app_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source = 'simulation'
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ts)),
b AS (SELECT *, sum(new_batch) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS batch FROM s)
SELECT min(ts) AS time,
       'Batch #' || batch || ': model v' || min(model_version) || ' on ' || min(dataset_version) || ' images'
         AS text,
       'batch' AS tags
FROM b GROUP BY batch ORDER BY batch
